name: VolcanoParasite
identity: Eyeless golden-ochre legless segmented parasite with an enormous ivory-toothed mouth, golden pale lower jaw and curved dark-brown volcanic horn spikes along its dorsal segments. No eyes, limbs, wings or separate tail.

source_observations.head: No eyes in original. Head carries upper teeth and three dark curved horns; separate lower jaw carries lower teeth. New axial Head cutouts include matching mouth/jaw, no invented eyes.
source_observations.body: Three progressively smaller golden spotted sections with pale underside and curved dark horns. Body/Segment/Tip remain distinct overlapped crawler sections; no extra tail or feet.
source_observations.back: Up must show closed rear cranium and horn backs, no eyes, nostrils or teeth.
source_observations.lifecycle: BaseEnemy.Init resets/rebinds direction profile and expression, OnRecycle restores flash/alpha/spawn scale and speed. Receiver SetHead preserves actual original side sprite references. Dedicated cloned curves must keep original float/PPtr curves, event times, duration and loops.
source_observations.motion: Existing crawler motion squashes/swells Body/Segment, small offset crawl wave, head lead on attack, attached fall plus BaseEnemy fade. No limb cadence.
source_observations.unity_occupancy: Main is currently playing, review/balance/manual are false. No stop or production install until editor is handed over.
